edition.notes: Only articles 1-15 are published. A party-hosted translation of a French original; no translator is named. Article 8 states the particular aim as the faithful observance of the liturgical and disciplinary traditions according to the dispositions of Ecclesia Dei; the word 'exclusive' does not occur.

passages.context: Articles 1-15 were read, including article 1 (clerical society of apostolic life of pontifical right, cf. can. 731 s. 1), article 6 (fidelity to the Roman Pontiff, can. 590 s. 2), article 7 (object), article 8 (particular aim: faithful observance of the liturgical and disciplinary traditions according to the dispositions of Ecclesia Dei), article 10 (studies on the principles and method of Saint Thomas Aquinas), article 13 (parochial ministry at a bishop's request, by agreement) and article 15 (auxiliaries, can. 738 s. 2).

work.author: Priestly Fraternity of Saint Peter
work.description: The fundamental code of the Priestly Fraternity of Saint Peter, approved ad experimentum for three years on 18 October 1988, amended by the general chapter of 2000, definitively approved by the Pontifical Commission Ecclesia Dei on 29 June 2003 (Prot. N. 108/2003), and amended by the general chapters of 2012 and 2018 with the approval of the Apostolic See (Prot. N. 153/2009). The complete text has never been published; only Part I, articles 1-15, is public.
work.title: Constitutions of the Priestly Fraternity of Saint Peter
